It is completely understandable that you are struggling to move on. While you might feel like your disappointment is just about the material aspects of the proposal and wedding, it sounds like the hurt runs much deeper. When you clearly communicate your desires and they are overlooked, it can make you feel unheard and undervalued by your partner. Your lingering anger and jealousy aren't just about a ring or a party; they are likely a natural response to feeling like your husband didn't prioritize what was deeply important to you. 

Hiding your disappointment and letting it spill over into small arguments is taking a heavy toll on your marriage. To truly move forward, it might help to have an honest, vulnerable conversation with your husband about why this hurt you so much—focusing on the feeling of not being heard rather than the events themselves. Exploring these feelings with a couples counselor could also provide a safe space to process this resentment and rebuild your connection.
